page.overview:
Who is Sivad?

Sivad was a human male Jedi Master during the Republic Era. He was short and stocky, and had a florid, friendly face, as well as white-blond hair. At some point, he took on an Ithorian as his Padawan. During the Clone Wars, Sivad served as a Jedi General and fought the Confederacy of Independent Systems in a siege on the planet Hebekrr Minor that lasted for several weeks. Sivad led a company of clone troopers alongside Clone Commander Sticks.
